name: Police Phase B - Restart Persistence Seed
description: Ordinary-player port robberies build a wanted incident that remains active for a serving-process restart readback.

tests.name: Rig: select a lawful port sector outside FedSpace

data.sql: SELECT cs.sector_id FROM cluster_sectors cs JOIN clusters c ON c.clusters_id=cs.cluster_id JOIN ports p ON p.sector_id=cs.sector_id WHERE c.role='RANDOM' AND c.law_severity>0 AND cs.sector_id>10 ORDER BY cs.sector_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: move ordinary player's active ship to lawful sector

data.sql: WITH active_ship AS (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{robbery_restart_player_player_id}), moved_ship AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{robbery_restart_sector} WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM active_ship) RETURNING ship_id) UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{robbery_restart_sector} WHERE player_id=@{robbery_restart_player_player_id};
WITH funded AS (UPDATE ports SET petty_cash=500000 WHERE sector_id=@{robbery_restart_sector} RETURNING port_id) SELECT port_id FROM funded LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: make ordinary player eligible to rob the port

data.sql: UPDATE players SET experience=10000, alignment=-300 WHERE player_id=@{robbery_restart_player_player_id};

tests.name: Robbery 1: ordinary player completes a lawful robbery
Rig: expire fake-bust window for a distinct second offence
Robbery 2: a second distinct offence persists
Rig: expire fake-bust window before threshold offence
Robbery 3: threshold offence promotes to wanted level one
Verify: incident is wanted one before restart
Verify: authoritative incident row is ready for restart check

data.sql: SELECT s.suspicion,s.wanted_level FROM cluster_player_status s JOIN cluster_sectors cs ON cs.cluster_id=s.cluster_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=s.player_id AND p.sector_id=cs.sector_id WHERE s.player_id=@{robbery_restart_player_player_id};
